name: men3d
description: Men-3D — PWA de menu digital interactivo en 3D/RA para restaurantes (SaaS multi-tenant)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @men3d/shared && npm run build -w @men3d/api && npm run build -w @men3d/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @men3d/api & npm run dev -w @men3d/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run models:sample && npm run build -w @men3d/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @men3d/shared && npm run typecheck -w @men3d/api && npm run typecheck -w @men3d/web
